review.omission_scan: Reviewed every original line for high-value verbs, everyday expressions, reusable frames and contrasts; workplace vocabulary is retained in context while the polite request and distance pattern are practiced.

review.transfer_scan: Selected the university-distance sentence as a teacher-created application of two distinct source lines, with a clear English gloss and one optional worked example on the Back.

tradeoffs.reason: The source expression already teaches the polite request directly and is shorter than the invented alternative.
